summary: Host only; nothing flashed or run on the phone and no XNU jump. Native run 004 stopped at the NAT-020 loader's fail("bad payload header"); check_payload.py (loader.c struct and condition text compiled unchanged, each || clause evaluated on its own) reproduces it on the exact flashed payload: only (p->adt_size & 7) fires, adt_size 13956. fix_payload.py rounds that u64 up to 13960 (the 12 bytes after the ADT are zero; it refuses non-zero padding, no padding, an overlapping segment, an already-aligned size). build.py now also builds loader-diag-trig-hold-adt8: same loader Image 901565b2..., Image.payload 766218b288b3fddaef79d7347f91b57aab5f7329e4d574389eb142226726a87a (differs from the run-004 Image.payload 7c6206bd..., which build.py still reproduces bit-for-bit, in exactly one byte: 0x84 -> 0x88 at offset 0x34028); all earlier images keep their hashes; two builds are identical. Packaged with the NAT-006 builder: RECOVERY image 38411cd82af4ae4b68079472d68936c23b3877208f301f33c295741ae991ce38 (21 bytes differ from the run-004 RECOVERY image: that byte and the 20-byte boot-header id). On the adt8 Image.payload no header clause fires; the loader's RAM/segment, ADT/boot_args room and entry blocks (text cut from loader.c) accept 256 and 512 MiB windows; the real adt_patch.c run in a guarded buffer with the loader's argument expressions returns 0 for the MPIDR, DRAM, pram and ramdisk calls for MPIDR 0, 0x80000000, 0x80000100, 0x80000400, 0xffffffff, with no guard overrun. Not evaluated: the RAM window the S-Boot DTB gives choose_window(), framebuffer selection, GIC, timing of zeroing/copying with the MMU off against the 83 s watchdog, any hardware effect. session_adt8.py (gated on decision 0013) stops before any device command while that file is missing (artifacts/nat-022/preflight-gate-005/report.json). A decision request for this image is put to the owner separately.
